description: This Java class `ResetConnectionMetrics` defines a command that resets the metrics of a specific Connection within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON, as well as metadata like command type and connection ID.

classes.name: ResetConnectionMetrics
classes.description: An immutable command class representing a request to reset the metrics of a specific connection identified by ConnectionId within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new ResetConnectionMetrics command instance with specified connection ID and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string or object to create a ResetConnectionMetrics command instance.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the command's payload into a JSON object builder, including the connection ID.

methods.name: getConnectionEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ConnectionId associated with this command.

methods.name: getCategory
methods.description: Returns the category of the command, which is MODIFY.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON Pointer indicating the resource path of the command.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance of the command with updated DittoHeaders.
